meta.name: The Thirteenth Guest
meta.description:
A young woman visits her childhood home, shuttered some 13 years after the fateful night her father died at the dinner table while they waited for a 13th guest. While reminiscing, she hears a noise. Frightened, she begins to explore. She screams. A shot is fired. On arrival, the police find the stiffened body of a young woman sitting at the dinner table.

Stars: Ginger Rogers, Lyle Talbot, and J. Farrell MacDonald
